images.label: Figure 1
images.caption:
Fig. 1. Taxol biosynthetic pathway starting from primary metabolism and including proposed intermediates, as well as metabolites which are proposed not to lead to Taxol
production. MEP, methylerythritol phosphate; IPP, isopentenyl diphosphate; DMAPP, dimethylallyl diphosphate; IPPI, isopentenyl diphosphate isomerase; GGPPS,
geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase; TS, taxadiene synthase. Figure modiﬁed from [48].

images.label: Figure 2
images.caption:
Fig. 2. Structures of TAX9 and TAX14 test substrates. (A, taxa-4(20),11(12)-dien-
5a,13a-diacetoxy-9a,10b-diol; B, 13-acetyl-9-dihydro-baccatin III).

images.label: Figure 3
images.caption:
Fig. 3. HPLC-radio chromatogram of the products generated from TAX9 using taxa-
4(20),11(12)-dien-5a,13a-diacetoxy-9a,10b-diol as substrate and [3H]acetyl CoA as
co-substrate. Assay conditions: 90 min at 31 C and pH 7.0; taxusin appears as the
main product due to the secondary acetylation of the primary products over time.

images.label: Figure 4
images.caption:
Fig. 4. Deduced amino acid sequence alignment of taxoid acetyl transferases: taxoid 5a-acetyl transferase (TAX 1), 10-DAB-10-O-acetyl transferase (TAX 6), taxoid 10b-acetyl
transferase (TAX 9), taxoid 9a-acetyl transferase (TAX 14), and taxoid 5a-acetyl transferase (TAX 19). Conserved motifs are highlighted.
